verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms API-side refund capability (create_refund, get_refund tools; 'Add server-side endpoints to handle refunds, voids, delayed captures') and dashboard-side refund ability ('Merchants can also add tracking, mark shipments, and issue refunds directly in the PayPal business dashboard'), covering both API and dashboard channels. However, there is no explicit documentation of partial vs full refund distinction, no dedicated Refunds API reference page, and community evidence shows disputes/chargeback handling can be inconsistent, though not specifically contradicting refund issuance itself. Missing for 10: explicit partial-refund API documentation/parameters, a dedicated Refunds API reference, and independent/hands-on confirmation of dashboard refund workflow.
